title: TMUA
pageTitle: TMUA Past Papers, Worked Solutions & Community Mocks | Arij Asad
description: Free TMUA official past papers, worked solutions, attributed community mocks, online simulators and topic worksheets, including Oxford, Warwick and Daniel J. Smith resources.
intro: Official papers and preparation materials, followed by free community mocks, online simulators, topic worksheets and video solutions. Papers and solutions are credited to their creators.
displayNotes: Official papers currently run from the 2016 practice papers to 2023, plus an early specimen. UAT-UK has not added 2024–2026 past papers to its public archive.
Add your Paper 1 and Paper 2 marks for a total out of 40. The boxes show the minimum total needed for overall scores of 7+, 8+ and 9 in that year, with 5+ and 6+ underneath.
These are historical conversions on the pre-2024 scale. Current TMUA results use a different scale; community mock conversions are estimates.

linkSections.title: Free university preparation resources
linkSections.description: University-produced worksheets, solutions and recordings to support TMUA preparation. These are teaching resources, not additional official TMUA exam papers.
linkSections.credit: Resources by the University of Oxford Mathematical Institute and the University of Warwick Mathematics Institute.

links.label: Oxford: 2026 worksheets, solutions and recordings
links.description: Fourteen topic and problem-solving sessions, from algebra and calculus to precision and creativity. The table links each worksheet, solution and recording. Free without registration. Includes questions from the 2020–2022 TMUA papers, so it may reveal papers you planned to save for mocks.

links.label: Warwick: TMUA video and written walkthroughs
links.description: Free university walkthroughs of selected past-paper questions, explaining approaches and the reasoning behind solutions.

linkSections.title: DπD Maths: free Set 1
linkSections.description: A free two-paper mock set, with 20 questions per paper and full worked solutions.
linkSections.credit: Questions and solutions by DπD Maths (Drishith Paturi and Ishan Dhakephalkar).

links.label: Set 1: Papers 1 and 2 with worked solutions
links.description: Choose TMUA Mock Set 1 or its free bundle on the publisher’s page and follow the “Get it free” access steps. This archive entry covers Set 1 only.

linkSections.title: Free online simulators
linkSections.description: Practise timing, navigation and answering on screen. The Pearson VUE link is the official practice environment; the other platforms are independent. Any community score conversions or difficulty ratings are estimates, not official results.
linkSections.credit: Platforms are credited below. Papers remain the work of their original authors; an online version is not necessarily a new paper.

links.label: Pearson VUE: official TMUA practice
links.description: Official UAT-UK computer-based specimen and practice tests. Start here to become familiar with the test interface.

links.label: JZMaths: free exam simulator
links.description: Free practice with official papers and original JZMaths and Tyler Tutoring mocks. A free account saves attempts and progress.

links.label: Clavis Education: three free practice sets
links.description: Original papers by Clavis Education in a timed simulator. Three two-paper sets; no account required.

links.label: MockLab999: free timed papers and mocks
links.description: Official 2016–2023 papers and MockLab999’s original two-paper mocks, with post-exam review. The public mocks need no sign-in.

links.label: tmua.io: free online paper practice
links.description: Free timed practice, automatic marking and saved results; Google sign-in required to sit papers. Choose official papers or named-author community papers. Its unattributed papers are not included in this archive.

links.label: TMUAmockz: free Set 01
links.description: Set 01 offers Papers 1 and 2 with unlimited attempts and worked solutions through a free account. Credit: TMUAmockz. Other sets are outside this free listing. The provider states that all paper and solution access ends after 9 January 2027.

links.label: JZMaths PLUS beta: free Exam Sets A and B
links.description: Four new papers by Joe Zhou, separate from the original Mock Sets, with worked solutions. Free membership requires completing two different full papers in the JZMaths simulator. Online only; free access ends 8 January 2027 at 11:59 pm GMT. This entry covers the free sets only.

sourceNote: This archive is curated by Arij Asad. Papers and solutions remain the work of their credited creators. Links lead to the original publishers, except for the Beyond Horizon and Yotta community downloads hosted here. The original file contents and credits are preserved. N/A means that an item is unavailable or not applicable. New resources are linked on their publishers’ websites. Only the free resources described in each entry are included; some providers also offer paid products. Signup requirements and published access limits are noted. Availability checked 27 October 2026.
communityOrderNote: The full mock-paper collections start with those offering the most free papers, followed by shorter practice collections. Topic worksheets and online simulator links appear below. The order is not a difficulty or quality ranking.
